2610.08327.title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
2610.08327.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.
2610.08327.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在醫療問題回答和臨床推理方面顯示出潛力，但其改進仍受到靜態參數知識和高昂專家監督的限制。自我進化代理提供了一種有前景的替代方案，通過使模型能夠通過迭代任務生成和問題解決來改進。然而，大多數現有的自我進化方法是為了易於驗證的領域而設計的，例如數學和編程，在這些領域中，解決方案可以通過精確答案或可執行程序來檢查。醫療推理根本上是不同的：它是開放式的、知識密集型的，且通常只能部分驗證。我們提出了MedZERO，一個用於開放式醫療推理的自我進化框架。MedZERO結合了一個生成前沿醫療問題-選項對的考官和一個通過基於證據的多輪推理與外部知識工具解決這些問題的推理器。為了支持可靠的持續改進，MedZERO採用了受控的知識積累，這保持了臨時的探索性知識和策劃的持久知識在推理中。我們在五個公共醫療推理基準上評估了MedZERO，使用4B和8B規模的基礎模型進行開放式評估。在所有設置中，MedZERO始終超越基礎模型和先前的自我進化基準，實現了高達13.7的平均準確度點增益，超過了下一個最佳的自我進化基準。
